retrieval: unchanged original BM25; identical fact hashes within each question
design_provenance: Designed using previous development diagnostics; exploratory development evaluation, not independent generalization. Frozen before new generation.
initial_gate: 24 answers only operational checks, no scores; remaining36 proceed unchanged. Systematic implementation/truncation failure preserves records and invalid comparisons, never selective failed-score retry.
adoption_principle: Consider correctness, factual support, unsupported guessing, unnecessary refusal, consistency across questions and rounds, and token/time cost together. Retain as candidate only with coherent benefit without systematic harm; no automatic default switch and no posthoc weighted score. Negative result is acceptable; no fourth scheme.
review: Correctness inputs hide arm/rules/history; quality uses actual input facts. Prompt signature may reveal arm: label-hidden, not fully blind. Once independent review per evidence-quality-v1. No human gold.
